name: Bay-breasted Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Hispaniola and gonâve island
description: A large cuckoo with an impressive tail and a rich maroon throat and breast. Found in low-to-moderate elevation deciduous woodlands.

name: White-throated Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Southern colombia to eastern ecuador, southeastern peru, northern bolivia, and western amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized woodpecker with a bold, yellow stripe through its face. Inhabits lowland and foothill rainforest.

name: Golden-winged Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Western highlands of vietnam (mount ngoc linh)
description: Restricted to high-elevation forest (above 2,000 meters) in the Annamite Mountains of central Vietnam. Predominantly gray with gold and rusty patches in the wings and tail.

name: Bourke's Parrot
rangeDescription: Locally in acacia scrub of interior of southern australia
description: Small pale parrot of inland Australia woodlands, often found in mulga and acacia scrubland. Gray-brown scaly upperparts set off by unique pastel pink underparts and blue underwing and rump.

name: Olive-spotted Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Far southeastern colombia to eastern ecuador, northeastern peru, and northwestern brazil
description: Medium-sized, drab-greenish hummingbird. Dull green above, with diffuse olive spotting underneath, and a white belly.

name: Madagascar Buzzard
rangeDescription: Woodland and savanna of madagascar
description: Typical brown buzzard that is endemic to Madagascar. Found throughout the island in many different habitats, though absent from pure grassland.

name: Eyebrowed Jungle Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern borneo (mount kinabalu and adjacent mountains)
description: Distinctive brownish flycatcher found in Borneo’s central and southeastern highland forests. Brown above and gray below, with a warm coffee-brown face and eye-catching white eyebrows and throat patch.

name: Southern Hill Myna
rangeDescription: Southwestern india (western ghats) and southern sri lanka
description: Glossy black myna of southern India and Sri Lanka. Note white wing patches, bright orange bill, and yellow head wattles.

name: Long-tailed Woodnymph
rangeDescription: Coastal eastern brazil (eastern pará to pernambuco and bahia)
description: Fairly large, slim hummingbird with a slightly forked tail and straight bill. Males have iridescent green and violet-blue plumage and females are green above and white below.

name: Sagebrush Sparrow
rangeDescription: Sagebrush and saltbush of great basin
description: Pale, subtly-patterned sparrow. Sandy-brown overall with gray head and whitish breast with dark central spotting.

name: Atlantic Royal Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (minas gerais, rio de janeiro, são paulo, and paraná)
description: Endemic to southeastern Brazil. Uncommon, medium-sized, overall brown flycatcher of humid tropical forest in lowlands.

name: Scarlet Ibis
rangeDescription: Coastal colombia to trinidad, the guianas, and northeastern brazil
description: Unmistakable, beautiful orange-red ibis with black wingtips. Breeding adults have black bills, pink at other times.

name: Cocos Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Cocos island (off western costa rica)
description: Small and drab flycatcher found only on Cocos Island, which is located in the Pacific Ocean about 300 miles southwest of mainland Costa Rica. Most birds are brown above with a buffy belly, with tan wingbars and a pale eyebrow.

name: Braun's Bushshrike
rangeDescription: Northwestern angola (cuanza norte escarpment)
description: A striking, mostly blackish bushshrike with a bright orange throat and breast, a chestnut crown and nape, and a white belly and wing-stripe. Pairs are scarce and skulky in the understory of secondary and gallery forest at only six localities near Uige along the Angolan escarpment, between 600 and 1260 meters of elevation.

name: Wedge-tailed Hillstar
rangeDescription: Andes of bolivia and adjacent argentina
description: Beautiful and distinctive hummingbird of Polylepis woodpland and adjacent scrub in the high Andes from the Argentina-Bolivia border to Cochabamba. Fairly rare.

name: White-eared Night Heron
rangeDescription: Southeastern china (from southeastern sichuan southward to central yunnan, eastward to southern anhui, zhejiang, guangdong, and hainan) and northern vietnam
description: Rare and elusive night-heron with a bug-eyed, almost “alien,” appearance. Highly localized, seldom encountered far from its nesting colonies and roost sites.

name: Turquoise Cotinga
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of southwestern costa rica to western panama (western chiriquí)
description: Unmistakable in range: male is stunning electric-blue with purple patch on throat and belly. Female completely different; pale grayish with heavy spotting below and scaling on back.

name: Gray Falcon
rangeDescription: Sparse in arid and semiarid areas of australia with scattered trees
description: Seldom-seen pale gray falcon of inland Australia found in arid grassland and woodland habitats, where it sometimes perches high on communication towers. Pale gray upperparts and white underparts, with faint dark streaks below.

name: Taiwan Partridge
rangeDescription: Montane forest of taiwan
description: Subtly patterned sphere of a bird; the only hill partridge (genus Arborophila) on Taiwan, where endemic. Black-and-white facial pattern is diagnostic, unlikely to be confused with any other native bird.

name: Ferruginous Hawk
rangeDescription: Prairies and plains of southern canada to northern mexico
description: Large raptor of dry open country; light morph much more common than dark morph. Light adult distinctly rufous above with blue-gray flight feathers, white breast, and rufous barring on sides.
